units.name: Management Department
units.evidence: The official department homepage explicitly names Management Department within Seidman College of Business and lists Operations/SCM teaching. Current catalog describes lean, six-sigma, ERP, inventory, forecasting/scheduling and service/manufacturing operational management.

units.name: Padnos College of Engineering
units.evidence: The current official OR Graduate Badge page explicitly names Padnos College of Engineering as host. Its three-course badge teaches constrained optimization, production/operational system modelling and logistics/manufacturing applications. Actual college retained; no standalone OR department or doctoral degree invented.

decisions.reason: Exact current Management Department and Seidman College host verified with explicit substantive Operations curriculum; one department retained.

sources.note: Read full 2026–2027 Management catalog page and all major/emphasis descriptions. Explicit Operations Management: lean, six-sigma, ERP, inventory, forecasting/scheduling and service/manufacturing operations. All listed awards undergraduate/BBA/badges/certificate.
